transcript.text: Good morning, everyone. Before we move forward with publishing the casting call, I'd like to hear from the equity liaison and safeguarding coordinator with their operational reports. As you know, I won't approve the call for release until I've received those reports at our daily sign-off. So please, go ahead whenever you're ready.
transcript.speaker: A1

transcript.text: I need to flag an important update. I confirmed with the performers' union office yesterday that the festival's agreement actually requires a $75 paid audition fee and limits each prepared audition side to exactly five minutes. This addendum arrived after the current draft of the casting call was circulated, and it has not yet been entered in the casting file. The draft as it stands doesn't specify an audition fee and uses ten-minute sides, so it will need to be revised before publication to comply with the union agreement.

transcript.text: I need to flag a critical safeguarding update. I confirmed with the child-safety officer this morning that applicants under 18 may audition only in guardian-supervised in-person sessions, may not be recorded, and require a dedicated safeguarding procedure in the published call. The officer's walk-through note is still awaiting filing, but the requirements are confirmed and effective now. Since the current draft accepts self-taped auditions and does not specify any special minor-participant procedure, it will need to be revised before publication to comply with these child-safety requirements.
